verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for payments and billing platforms, since self-hostable payment-orchestration and billing products exist, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Airwallex can be self-hosted. Everything documented is Airwallex-hosted: the payment page, the remote MCP endpoint at mcp.airwallex.com, the sandbox and the API, with the CLI acting only as a client to that hosted service.
